title: Itachi Uchiha UI for Minecraft PE (Naruto Menu)
topic: Naruto ke Itachi Uchiha se inspired red-and-black UI resource pack ka showcase.
description: Naruto ke Itachi Uchiha se inspired red-and-black UI resource pack ka showcase. Video mein Minecraft PE/Bedrock ke interface ko themed look dene wale elements — custom main menu, loading screen, hotbar aur inventory visuals — dikhaye gaye hain. Is tarah ke pack ka main purpose visual customisation hota hai; yeh apne aap gameplay abilities ya performance upgrade nahi karta.
